paragraphs.text: I am applying for the staff data platform engineer opening. My work has centered on streaming ingestion and on the governance that keeps a regulated platform trustworthy.

Earlier I modeled a clinical reporting warehouse and its nightly load, which is where I learned how analysts actually read a model.
